In summary, our research is concerned with

the investigation of the high temperature behaviour of the noncommutable quantum electrodynamics in 2+1 dimensions, in order to find out the possible effects of noncommutativity in the critical behaviour of the theory.
the study of the thermodynamic stability of noncommutativity in the presence of fermions.
the analysis of the high T behaviour of noncommutativity effects on a non-Abelian gauge theory.

the noncommutativity has a destabilizing effect on the system.
the critical temperature of noncommutativity decreases as the temperature increases, as a consequence of the fermionic contributions.
the inclusion of the fermionic sector in the theory leads to an enhancement of the thermodynamic stability.

the noncommutativity of the space-time coordinates leads to an increase in the value of the free energy of the system.
